name: Basketball (Size 7)
summary: Original size-7 basketball with pebbled orange rubber and recessed black eight-panel seams.
description: Brand-neutral 29.5 in (74.9 cm) basketball. Two perpendicular great-circle seams cross at the poles and two curved C seams loop around the sides, giving the standard eight-panel layout. Channels are real recessed geometry; the pebbled grain is a baked tangent-space normal map. Static visual asset; no physics.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry (UV sphere minus exact-Boolean round seam tubes) and a Cycles-baked 3D Voronoi pebble normal map; no external assets, logos or text.

display.origin: Floor contact point under the ball centre (seam crossing at the bottom pole)

accuracy_notes: Skin diameter 238.6 mm (circumference 749.6 mm, inside the FIBA/NBA size-7 range). Seam channels are 6 mm wide and 3 mm deep round grooves; measured extents read up to 0.3 mm under the skin diameter because the extreme axis points sit inside channels. C-seam shape is an elongated small circle (54 deg +/- 6 deg) approximating real ball layouts, not a manufacturer drawing. Pebble grain is a normal map only (silhouette is smooth). No inflation, bounce or physics.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, materials and baked texture; no external models, fonts, images or logos.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
